introHtml: Collared gift boxes add a polished, finished look that standard boxes lack. The integrated collar creates a clean edge for ribbon wrapping, making them ideal for corporate gift sets, retail packaging, or employee recognition kits. Decorate with dye-sublimated ribbons or full-color printed ribbons to match your brand colors. Perfect for marketing directors and HR managers who want presentation-grade packaging without extra assembly.
